title: docgen config (docgen.yaml)
description: The INPUT contract: how the generator runs. Resolution order is built-in defaults < org base (via extends) < this repo file < CLI flags. The resolved render/llm/toolchain values are copied into manifest.json as provenance and feed inputsHash, so this file is what makes the hermetic guarantee auditable. Secrets are NEVER stored here -- only the names of env vars that hold them.

version.description: Config schema version; bumped on breaking shape changes.

extends.description: Org base config to inherit (URL or path). This is the DRY lever: set palette, llm, and quadrant policy ONCE org-wide; repos override only what differs.

profile.description: Output structure. divio = the numbered quadrant layout; flat = single README-style tree.

pathFilters.description: CI regen trigger: a merge regenerates only when files matching these change. Empty = regen on any change.

languages.description: Reference-tool toolchain. auto=true detects languages and uses pinned defaults; tools[] overrides per language. Pinned versions are what make the Reference quadrant hermetic.

quadrants.description: Per-quadrant generation policy. generate=tool owns it (may overwrite); stub=scaffold placeholder only if missing; human=never touch; skip=don't create.

render.description: Diagram rendering. Mirrors manifest.generator.render -- these are inputs, so changing them busts inputsHash and forces regeneration.

llm.description: Drives the Explanation quadrant only. apiKeyEnv names the env var holding the secret -- the key itself is NEVER in this file (it is committed to repos).

promptOverride.description: Path to a custom prompt template; default uses the built-in pinned prompt.

binary.description: Path to codebase-memory-mcp, or auto to discover on PATH.

drift.description: The docgen drift subcommand (PR check). Uses manifest covers[] to find stale docs.

publish.description: Optional per-repo publish adapter. The org search app does NOT use this -- it ingests the manifest directly.

target.description: Adapter-specific destination (gh-pages branch, S3/GCS bucket, etc.).
